title: Removal of the Auxiliary Power Unit Firewall Panel from the Aft Compartment

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of the auxiliary power unit firewall panel from the aft compartment, used for compartment corrosion inspection, for drain mast work and as the first step of the reworked panel installation.

sections.purpose: This task removes the firewall panel from the auxiliary power unit compartment so that the compartment structure can be inspected or the drain mast can be worked on.
sections.job_setup_note: The auxiliary power unit must be shut down and cool, the fire bottle must be safetied and the compartment must be ventilated before entry. The panel is a fire barrier; every fastener position must be recorded as it is removed, because the panel cannot be refitted with a fastener missing and the positions are not all the same length.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the auxiliary power unit is shut down and that the master switch is off. 2. Safety the fire bottle and put the warning notice in the flight compartment. WARNING: DO NOT ENTER THE AUXILIARY POWER UNIT COMPARTMENT UNTIL THE FIRE BOTTLE IS SAFETIED AND THE COMPARTMENT HAS BEEN VENTILATED. 3. Measure the compartment temperature and wait until it is below the limit in the instructions. 4. Open the compartment doors and get access to zones 391, 394 and 396. 5. Record the fastener positions on the layout sheet before removal. CAUTION: THE PANEL FASTENERS ARE NOT ALL THE SAME LENGTH. A LONG FASTENER FITTED IN A SHORT POSITION WILL BOTTOM AND CRACK THE FRAME LAND. 6. Disconnect and label the drain line at the clamp D4910115671824. 7. Remove the cowl latch D4910112220209 and put it in the parts tray. 8. Remove the panel fasteners in the reverse of the torque sequence. 9. Support the panel and lower it clear of the frame. 10. Remove the seal at FIN 9606PB and discard it. 11. Do a detailed visual inspection of the panel lower edge and of the frame land for corrosion, and record every finding with its position. 12. Inspect the heat shield at FIN 633PB for distortion and report any finding before further work.
sections.close_out: Blank the compartment aperture if the aircraft is to be left overnight. Put the panel on a clean flat surface and protect the sealing face. Make an entry in the technical log that the auxiliary power unit must not be started until the panel is installed.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The formed lower edge applies post MOD-152210.

safety_precautions: Safety the fire bottle before entry.
Ventilate the compartment and confirm the temperature is below the limit.
Record every fastener position before removal.
